reasoning_content:
Image built. Now bring up. The app will try to signin to the fake tenant URL and fail at startup, causing the container to exit/restart. Let's see.

The guide says to configure .env with settings for your setup. We don't have real credentials. The README mentions USE_MOCKUP for local frontend development with mock backend on localhost:8002. But the guide's documented method is docker compose. Let's try docker compose up -d and observe.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker compose up -d 2>&1; sleep 15; docker compose ps -a; echo "=== logs ==="; docker compose logs --tail=50
